name: כַּשְׂדִּי
summary: The Chaldeans, the nation Yahweh raised up against Judah, after whom Ur of the Chaldeans, Abram’s first home, is named. The text gives no derivation of the name.

evidence.note: The verse identifies הַכַּשְׂדִּים as הַגּוֹי, “the nation.”
אוּר כַּשְׂדִּים identifies Ur by the people associated with it.
Terah’s household departs מֵאוּר כַּשְׂדִּים, “from Ur of the Chaldeans.”
Yahweh tells Abram that he brought him מֵאוּר כַּשְׂדִּים, “from Ur of the Chaldeans.”

note: Moved from the former word entry `kkaceddiy` (old root key כשׂד). A tie to Abraham’s nephew כֶּשֶׂד (Gen 22:22) is not shown. TIPNR has no group record for the Chaldeans: it files כַּשְׂדִּים under Chaldea@Gen.11.28, which is named here.
